question: What is the new name of the India-England Test series? (June 2025)
solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Tendulkar-Anderson Trophy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India, England to now play for the Tendulkar-Anderson trophy.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
The India-England Test cricket series is now renamed the **Tendulkar-Anderson Trophy**, honoring Sachin Tendulkar and James Anderson.

 
 
• 
 
The announcement was made jointly by the **England and Wales Cricket Board (ECB)** and the **Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI)**.

 
 
• 
 
The trophy will be officially unveiled by Tendulkar and Anderson on **June 11, 2025**, during the World Test Championship (WTC) final at Lord’s.

 
 
• 
 
The next India-England series will start on **June 20, 2025**, with a five-Test series at Headingley, Leeds.

 
 
• 
 
**James Anderson** retired in July 2024, played 188 Tests, took over 700 wickets — the first fast bowler to reach that milestone.

 
 
• 
 
**Sachin Tendulkar** retired in 2013, played 200 Tests, scored 15,921 runs with 51 centuries.

 
 
• 
 
Previously, the series used different trophies: the **Pataudi Trophy** (in England) and the **Anthony de Mello Trophy** (in India).

 
 
• 
 
The new trophy unifies the series identity and celebrates two cricket legends from the modern era.
